As reflected in its title, the text examines questions surrounding suicide and taking one's own life, thematic material traditionally related to the narrative context of the *Pāyāsi Sutta* (DN 23) and the monastic regulation governing the destruction of human life in the third *Pārājika* rule of the *Bhikkhu Vibhaṅga* [SuttaCentral].
